functions.name: unaccent
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cleverchat_dev.unaccent(source text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$
    SELECT source
$function$
